Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 30

“The Gandiva slips from my hand, my skin burns all over, I am unable to stand steady, and my mind seems to reel.”

The great bow falling from his grip is the detail that matters — Gandiva is a divine weapon and his whole identity as an archer. His body is surrendering before he has decided anything.
